text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
JERUSALEM POST
- Clinton willing to meet PA negotiators
- 32 Hebron rioters wounded
- Mossad official to head TAU Jaffee Centre
- Judaica on CD-ROM
- Mordechai: PA helps prevent unrest, not terrorism
HAARETZ
- Israel working to thwart Gaza port construction
- Arafat rejected appeal to renew security coordination
- Psychologists who examined "Cherry" undercover unit: the unit is in crisis, soldiers afraid of operations
- Merryll Lynch, Lehman Brothers to market Bank Leumi issue in Europe
YEDIOTH AHRONOTH
- Security coordination with Palestinians renewed
- Netanyahu in Netherlands
- German concern cancels investments in Israel under Arab pressure
- Israeli fights to death with giant crocodile in Costa Rica
MAARIV
- Arafat rejected request to renew coordination
- Maariv publisher Nimrodi sues Channel 2 TV for report of his involvement in attorney-general appointment scandal
- Estimate at Treasury: rate of growth since the start of the year - zero
GLOBES
- High supply of foreign currency but dollar reaches high of 3.39 shekels
- Hundreds of thousands of litres of cheap wine were sold in Israel as quality kosher wine
